title: [review] project-LICHEN-636h.3: Loopback setter calls Disconnect without connectionLock
description: In SX1262.cs Line 51, the Loopback property setter calls `Disconnect()` and then sets `loopbackMode = value` on line 52 without holding connectionLock. Disconnect itself locks connectionLock internally, but the mode assignment is outside the lock. A concurrent EnsureConnected() call (which also takes connectionLock) could reconnect before loopbackMode is toggled, creating a brief window where the connection uses the wrong mode. Fix: wrap the body in `lock (connectionLock) { ... }`.
